Parameters for R markdown and the general running of the code.

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, 
                      cache = FALSE,
                      autodep = FALSE)
start_time = Sys.time()
recompute_analyses = FALSE 
```

Parameters necessary to use the package BEMOVI (includes sampling parameters).

```{r}
fps = 25 #Frames per second 
seconds_per_video = 5
total_frames = fps * seconds_per_video
measured_volume = 34.4 #volume measured for each video in µL
volume_recorded_μl = measured_volume
volume_recorded_ml = volume_recorded_μl * 10^-3
pixel_to_scale = 4.05
filter_min_net_disp = 25
filter_min_duration = 1 
filter_detection_freq = 0.1
filter_median_step_length = 3

time_points = 0:7
time_point_names = c("t0", "t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7") #Get rid of after new data assembly
sampling_days = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28)
# time_points_for_ES = 1:4
first_time_point = 0 #Get rid of after new data assembly
last_time_point = length(sampling_days) - 1 #Get rid of after new data assembly
n_time_points = last_time_point + 1 #Get rid of after new data assembly
time_point_day = data.frame(time_point = first_time_point:last_time_point,
                            day = sampling_days) #Get rid of after new data assembly

threshold_levels = c(13, 40) #These are the two lower threshold for pixel intensity for imageJ to distinguish between background and foreground. We analysed the videos using 13 as the minimum threshold, then did the same with 40. 

video.description.folder = "0_video_description/"
video.description.file = "video_description.txt"
merged_data_folder = "5_merged_data/"

columns_for_species_ID = c("mean_grey",
                           "sd_grey",
                           "mean_area",
                           "sd_area",
                           "mean_perimeter",
                           "mean_turning",
                           "sd_turning",
                           "sd_perimeter",
                           "mean_major",
                           "sd_major",
                           "mean_minor",
                           "sd_minor",
                           "mean_ar",
                           "sd_ar",
                           "duration",
                           "max_net",
                           "net_disp",
                           "net_speed",
                           "gross_disp",
                           "max_step",
                           "min_step",
                           "sd_step",
                           "sd_gross_speed",
                           "max_gross_speed",
                           "min_gross_speed")
```

```{r}
resource_flow_days = c(5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25)
```

Parameters related to protists.

```{r}
#New
protist_species = c("Ble", "Cep", "Col", "Eug", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi", "Spi_te", "Tet")
protist_species_indiv_per_ml = paste0(protist_species, "_indiv_per_ml")
protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = paste0(protist_species, "_bioarea_mm2_per_ml")
protist_species_dominance = paste0(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml, "_dominance")

species_IDD_with_13_threshold = c("Col", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi_te", "Tet")
species_IDD_with_40_threshold = c("Ble", "Cep", "Spi")

#Old
protist_species_hetero = c("Ble", "Cep", "Col", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi", "Spi_te", "Tet")
protist_species_hetero_indiv_per_ml = paste0(protist_species_hetero, "_indiv_per_ml")
protist_species_hetero_indiv_per_volume = paste0(protist_species_hetero, "_indiv_per_volume")
protist_species_hetero_dominance = paste0(protist_species_hetero_indiv_per_ml, "_dominance")
protist_species_hetero_total = paste0(protist_species_hetero, "_tot_indiv")
n_protist_species_hetero = length(protist_species_hetero)
species_IDD_with_13_threshold = c("Col", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi_te", "Tet")
species_IDD_with_13_threshold_indiv_per_volume = paste0(species_IDD_with_13_threshold, "_indiv_per_volume")
species_IDD_with_40_threshold = c("Ble", "Cep", "Spi")
species_IDD_with_40_threshold_indiv_per_volume = paste0(species_IDD_with_40_threshold, "_indiv_per_volume")
```

Parameters related to meta-ecosystems.

```{r experiment}
metaecosystems_to_take_off = NA

system_nr_metaecosystems = culture_info %>%
  filter(metaecosystem == "yes") %>%
  pull(system_nr) %>%
  unique

n_metaecosystems = length(system_nr_metaecosystems)

columns_metaecos = c("time_point",
                     "day",
                     "system_nr",
                     "system_type",
                     "patch_size_ml",
                     "patches_combined")

variables_metaecos = "total_metaecosystem_bioarea_mm2"

metaecosystem_types_ordered = c(
  "Small meta-ecosystem (s)",
  "Small two-patch isolated (s)",
  "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem (s)",
  "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s)",
  "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem (s)",
  "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s)",
  "Large meta-ecosystem (s)",
  "Large two-patch isolated (s)",
  "Small meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
  "Small two-patch isolated (s*d)",
  "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
  "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s*d)",
  "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
  "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s*d)",
  "Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
  "Large two-patch isolated (s*d)"
)

treatments_and_controls_metaecos = data.frame(
  treatment = c(
    "Small meta-ecosystem (s)",
    "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem (s)",
    "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem (s)",
    "Large meta-ecosystem (s)",
    "Small meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
    "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
    "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)",
    "Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)"
  ),
  control = c(
    "Small two-patch isolated (s)",
    "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s)",
    "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s)",
    "Large two-patch isolated (s)",
    "Small two-patch isolated (s*d)",
    "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s*d)",
    "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s*d)",
    "Large two-patch isolated (s*d)"
  )
)

metaecosystems_renamed = data.frame(
  new = c("Small meta-ecosystem",
          "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem",
          "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem",
          "Large meta-ecosystem"
  ),
  old = c("small",
          "small-medium",
          "medium-large",
          "large")
)

names = data.frame(
  system_type = "Small two-patch isolated (s*d)", green_patch = "AutoS_absolute", blue_patch = "HeteroS_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s*d)", green_patch = "AutoSM_absolute", blue_patch = "HeteroSM_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s*d)", green_patch = "AutoML_absolute", blue_patch = "HeteroML_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Large two-patch isolated (s*d)", green_patch = "AutoL_absolute", blue_patch = "HeteroL_absolute") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Small two-patch isolated (s)", green_patch = "AutoS_relative", blue_patch = "HeteroS_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s)", green_patch = "AutoSM_relative", blue_patch = "HeteroSM_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s)", green_patch = "AutoML_relative", blue_patch = "HeteroML_relative") %>%
  add_row(system_type = "Large two-patch isolated (s)", green_patch = "AutoL_relative", blue_patch = "HeteroL_relative")

isolated_two_patch_systems = data.frame(
  system_type = as.character(NA),
  green_patch_IDs = as.character(NA),
  blue_patch_IDs = as.character(NA)
) %>%
  slice(-1)

for(row_i in 1:nrow(names)) {
  
  isolated_two_patch_systems = isolated_two_patch_systems %>%
    add_row(
      system_type = names$system_type[row_i],
      green_patch_IDs = culture_info %>%
        filter(eco_metaeco_type == names$green_patch[row_i]) %>%
        pull(culture_ID) %>%
        paste(., collapse = ", "),
      blue_patch_IDs = culture_info %>%
        filter(eco_metaeco_type == names$blue_patch[row_i]) %>%
        pull(culture_ID) %>%
        paste(., collapse = ", ")
    )
}
```

```{r}
  add_row(treatment = "Large two-patch isolated (s)", colour = "#e31a1c", linetype = "longdash") %>%
  
  add_row(treatment = "Small meta-ecosystem (s*d)", colour = "#ffffb2", linetype = "solid") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Small-Medium meta-ecosystem (s*d)", colour = "#fecc5c", linetype = "solid") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Medium-Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)", colour = "#fd8d3c", linetype = "solid") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Large meta-ecosystem (s*d)", colour = "#e31a1c", linetype = "solid") %>%
  
  add_row(treatment = "Small two-patch isolated (s*d)", colour = "#ffffb2", linetype = "longdash") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Small-Medium two-patch isolated (s*d)", colour = "#fecc5c", linetype = "longdash") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Medium-Large two-patch isolated (s*d)", colour = "#fd8d3c", linetype = "longdash") %>%
  add_row(treatment = "Large two-patch isolated (s*d)", colour = "#e31a1c", linetype = "longdash") %>%
  slice(-1)
```
